statement: Borsa Italiana 'Trading Calendar and Hours', Year 2026: 'For the year 2026, Borsa Italiana adopted the following closing days for its markets: every Saturday; every Sunday; Thursday 1st January; Friday 3rd of April (Good Friday) and Monday 6th of April (Easter Monday); Friday 1st of May (Labor Day); Thursday 24th (Christmas Eve), Friday 25th (Christmas) and Thursday 31st of December (New Year's Eve); as well as, limited to the multilateral trading system called Trading After Hours, for the following sessions: ...'. Only 2026 is published, so the horizon ends on 2026-12-31.

sources.covers: 2026 closing days of Borsa Italiana markets
Euronext 2026 holiday table, column Milan: closed 1 Jan, 3 Apr, 6 Apr, 1 May, 24 Dec, 25 Dec, 31 Dec (consistent)
'Appendix of Trading Manual 4-01', effective 19 October 2026, 'Trading hours in CET': continuous equities groups on Milan: continuous trading 09:00-17:30, closing uncross 17:35

notes: Closures that apply only to the Trading After Hours MTF (segment MIC MTAH) are not holidays of the regulated market and are not encoded.
The equity regulated market is Euronext Milan, segment MIC MTAA under operating MIC XMIL (ISO 10383 list, retrieved 2026-10-22).
regular_session is the continuous-trading phase of continuous ('C') equity groups, in CET/CEST (Europe/Rome).
Settlement is counted on T2S-EUR, not on this file.
